messages:
tess: Heads-up — pre-retest ops sync for the ACME pen test. Need to lock down the verification cadence and RBAC windows. Who's on call for evidence packaging?

alex: I can own the evidence snapshot upload. Quick Q: do we want assessor-facing presigned urls or readroom access again?

maggie: presigned urls are easier for triage but readroom gives better audit chain. leaning readroom if they need live session access.

owen: +1 readroom for live. also reminder: staging uses alias/key rotation this week. KMS alias change may break previously exported sealed artifacts.

raj: Which alias? is this the one used by log-ingest service? need to ensure we have exported audit logs before rotation.

nowen: alias: alias/redwood-pt-staging. rotation scheduled 2025-08-14T02:00Z. we'll snapshot CloudAudit exports prior.

sec-bot: Reminder: retention policy for cloud audit logs is 90d. Export job started: job-20250813-2305.

alex: Good. I'll pull the export after job completes and store into evidence bucket with KMS encryption using alias/redwood-pt-evidence (separate key).

maggie: For RBAC: assessors will need ephemeral role ARN: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor-readonly-temporary. Window should be 2h by default. Anyone object?

tess: 2h ok. Add a second window for retest if they request. Also we must capture session recordings and break out requests by JIRA id.

raj: On audit logging: we need request-level tracing for the KMS encrypt/decrypt calls during evidence uploads. Can we enable CloudTrail data events for kms:Decrypt on the evidence bucket?

nowen: we can add kms:Decrypt data event for the S3 object-level ops. I'll raise a terraform change: 2 lines to enable data event mapping.

alex: For remediation verification: propose checklist -> (1) PR merged, (2) staging deploy, (3) e2e smoke, (4) exploit attempt by assessor in readroom, (5) evidence upload + logs exported.

maggie: Can we tag the JIRA tickets with remediation-verification/<slot> so we can search and attach to audit?

tess: yes. we'll use tag format pt-verify-YYYYMMDD. Add to runbook.

sec-bot: New runbook update pushed: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/pt-retest-ops (changeset 8f3a).

raj: Minor RBAC ask: when we create ephemeral role, can we restrict kms:Decrypt to only alias/redwood-pt-evidence key? don't want assessors able to decrypt other artifacts.

nowen: yep scope the policy. here's the diff I plan to apply:

```
- Resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/*
+ Resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:alias/redwood-pt-evidence
```

alex: one more: remediation tracker link? I updated the sprint board but want canonical tracker for retest owners.

maggie: use /security/pt-remediate tracker (JIRA board: PT-RETEST). I'll assign owners after this sync.

tess: schedule: retest dry-run Fri 2025-08-15 15:00 UTC, live retest Mon 2025-08-18 09:00 UTC. Owners: alex (evidence), raj (logs/export), nowen (kms/iam), maggie (ops liaison).

alex: ack. I'll prepare presigned url fallback in case readroom can't be scheduled.

raj: I'll run a quick audit export checklist and share the S3 manifest in the tracker when done.

nowen: will push the terraform change for ephemeral role + kms scoping in a PR and tag @maggie for review.

maggie: will review. also adding a step to rotate the ephemeral session cookie every 30m during the assessor window.

tess: perfect. last item: evidence checksum policy — we require SHA256 on every uploaded artifact and a signed manifest. alex pls confirm format.

alex: will use manifest.jsonl with fields: {"object","sha256","uploaded_by","ts","jira"} — I'll drop sample in the tracker.

sec-bot: Action items created: #4532 evidence-upload, #4533 kms-scope-pr, #4534 audit-export, #4535 retest-schedule.

tess: thanks all. if nothing else, we'll reconvene 2025-08-14 10:00 UTC for a final preflight.

maggie: thanks — adding calendar invite. :white_check_mark:

alex: I'll post the sample manifest and presigned fallback before EOD.

nowen: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/789 (kms+iam). tagging reviewers.

raj: export complete, manifest uploaded to S3: s3://pt-evidence/1780012345/manifest-20250813.json. linking in tracker.

tess: all set. good run.
